flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: the specimens differ (PBMCs stimulated with YF17D peptide pools versus purified CD4+ T cells co-cultured with autologous dendritic cells) and the intracellular marker/readout sets differ (IL-2 and IFN-γ in activated vaccine-specific CD4 T cells versus IFN-γ, IL-5, IL-13, and CD154 in CD4+ T cells).

flow cytometry assay (3) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures intracellular cytokine-producing activated vaccine-specific CD4 T cells (CD154, IL-2, IFN-γ), whereas Record B measures memory-polarized CD154+ Th1/Th2 CD4 T-cell subsets defined by phenotypic markers (CD45RA, CCR7, CCR4, CXCR3, CCR6).
